classification.difficultyReason: The task is a heavily scaffolded piecewise CDF. Parts a and b are direct integration and substitution, and part c states the method (add F(2) to the integral from 2 to x), so no insight is needed. The main demands are keeping the constant of integration through the second piece, with a little algebraic simplification, and in part d choosing the correct CDF piece for F(3) and F(1) before subtracting. That is a routine linked procedure, slightly above the single-piece CDF and probability tasks in p35-q7 and p38-q12. It is below p34-q5, where the student must find c and build the piecewise CDF unaided, and below p42-q3, which needs a median found by solving an equation after setting up the CDF.
